eight_query_benchmark.comparisons_scope: first baseline run against the clean candidate run
eight_query_benchmark.pooled_scope: both runs of each arm, 30 samples per arm
regressions: Q8: Join users + orders (pooled median +17.2%, pooled min +13.1%; every candidate run slower than every baseline run)
Q1: Full table count (pooled median +13.6%, pooled min +23.1%; about 0.3 ms absolute)
slower_within_host_noise: Q5: Monthly revenue (2023) (pooled median +9.0%, pooled min +6.7%)
eight_query_benchmark.background: No unrelated containers. The host's own management agents ran in brief bursts; see the host-load samples.
eight_query_benchmark.interpretation: Pooled over two runs per arm, Q8 (median +17.2%, min +13.1%) and Q1 (median +13.6%, min +23.1%, about 0.3 ms) are regressions; Q5 is slower by 9.0% median and 6.7% min, within this host's run-to-run spread. The single clean pair shows every query but Q7 10-23% slower on the median, which the baseline repeat shows is partly host noise.

tpch.placement: native process on the probe host; the MySQL source ran in a container on the same host
tpch.buffer_pool: Raised to 4 GiB by a watcher outside the repository once the final server answered over TCP, while it counted no line-item rows, and read back at 4 GiB when the replica was ready, before the queries, in every pass.

discarded_runs.reason: A first set of six alternating passes (all exact) ran with an earlier watcher that could not show it had reached the final MySQL server rather than the image's initialization server; discarded, not banked.

uniform_probe.interpretation: Decoded blocks identical in both arms. Dense text scans (text-all, text-selective) are about 23% slower in 0.1.6 on median and minimum; mixed-selective 7% slower; numeric-filter query 13% slower (16% on the minimum). Narrow and wide scans and the other queries are unchanged; wide arithmetic is 7% faster. Reported as a regression; not attributed to a commit.

host_observation.host_type: 8-vCPU cloud host (AMD Ryzen 9 9950X), 15 GiB RAM, local docker daemon
host_observation.note: 0.1.5 ran on a 32-logical-CPU build host with a separate 16-logical-CPU docker host; compare arms only within this requalification.
unexpected_high_cpu_processes: The hosts' own management agents appeared in brief bursts: about two logical CPUs during the baseline scan probe and about four during the third baseline TPC-H pass and the third candidate pass's seeding.
host_observation.scope: Includes this study's own builds, seeding, snapshots and harness containers; load averages are whole-host figures, not background-only.

eight_query_benchmark.interpretation: The largest engine-track median slowdown is 5.8%; its minimum improves. The largest minimum slowdown is 2.8%. These do not establish a substantial regression beyond the documented shared-hardware noise allowance. No general benchmark speedup is claimed. The harness automatic previous-run check requires identical source fingerprints and therefore does not compare these code revisions; this comparison uses their raw samples explicitly.

tpch.initial_baseline_failure: Q05 exceeded the default 1 GiB query spill quota. The failed result is retained separately; both arms use the same larger spill limits for the comparison.

uniform_probe.interpretation: Scan-bound SQL improves 1.26–1.51x. Wide arithmetic is 1.018x: no material gain. Wide projected scan is 1.046x. The earlier 0.99x and 1.03x observations do not establish a regression.
